definition.unresolved_regions: Cannot serve as negative supervision. Frame ineligible for ordinary fullframe three-class training until resolved.

scope: Only the 18 proposed training images; all 81 original tag rectangles remain unchanged. No evaluation head/body annotations or model outputs used. Native image context and clean full-image previews inspected; coordinates restored from the displayed preview scale. Small background instances and ambiguous attachments remain explicitly unresolved rather than invented. Two full frames independently AI-reviewed; all other full frames ineligible.
